predator.name: Apex Stalker
predator.text: Deal 12+ total damage: +2 attack; your attacks ignore Fortify's damage halving.

predator.name: Frenzy Form
predator.text: End a round at 9+ Strain with no rejection: the Overclocked bonus becomes +2.

parasite.name: Hive Host
parasite.text: The opponent suffers a rejection: heal 3 whenever the opponent rejects a graft.

parasite.name: Leech Form
parasite.text: The opponent reaches 8+ Strain: your Toxins also drain 1 HP.

bastion.name: Carapace
bastion.text: Vent 6 total Strain: +3 armor; Fortify vents 3 instead of 2.

bastion.name: Juggernaut
bastion.text: Block 10 total damage: your armor adds to your attack.
